settings.title: How blind boxes work
settings.content: Each box contains one random figure from the series. You can't choose or see the character before opening. Duplicates are possible, and the secret figure (≈ 1 in 72 boxes per the manufacturer) is never guaranteed.

settings.question: What's inside a blind box?
settings.answer: One sealed box contains one random figure from the Culling Game series: one of the six standard characters or, rarely, the secret figure. You only find out who when you open it.

settings.question: Can I choose my character?
settings.answer: No. Every box is sealed and identical from the outside, which is the whole point of the ritual. If you want more chances at a specific character, bigger formats lower the price per box.

settings.question: Can I get duplicates?
settings.answer: Yes. Each box is random, so duplicates are possible, including in the 3-box pack. A 6-box display is a full manufacturer case; we do not guarantee a complete set or the secret figure.

settings.question: What are the odds of the secret figure?
settings.answer: The manufacturer states roughly 1 secret in every 72 boxes. It is never guaranteed, whatever format you buy.
